steps.npc: Granddad's fruit farm. It's a right dump. This whole corner of the city is a dump.

options.text: So why are you here if it's a dump?

steps.player: So why are you here if it's a dump?

steps.npc: My cow of a sister kicked me out of her bar. Said I was getting the place a bad name. So I'm staying here until I'm old enough to get my own place.
I want to move to Arceuus. It's properly awesome up there. I'll do bartending or something until I can learn to be a necromancer.
Anyway, why are you here? Do you want something?
Yeah, you're in the biggest dumpster of Dumpsterville. Now you know. Anyway, do you want something?
Yeah, alright...
I am Bologa Gricoller, seeker of forbidden wisdom, wanderer of the dark pathways, thinker of the unthinkable. I can do bartending too.
I used to work at The Golden Field. That's my sister's bar. It's mostly farmhands drinking there, but you get some interesting people as well.
See, most Hosidius people are Saradominists. My sister, she's always listening to Father Jean at the church with his goodie-goodie sermons.
But some of us in the bar thought we'd give Zamorak a try. Like, you gotta be open-minded, right? What did Saradomin ever do for us anyway?
So we'd meet in the bar, sharing books that the Piscarilius smugglers would bring us, learning what the Saradominists don't want us to know.
Anyway, my sister - she's a right cow, by the way - she fired me and kicked me out. Said I was bringing bad sorts to her bar.
Bad sorts, she said! Like, morality is totally subjective, right? So who's she to call us bad sorts just 'cos we're not afraid to think differently?
Anyway, I've learnt all this cool stuff about Zamorak, and being stuck in a fruit farm doesn't stop me being his loyal servant, right?
In fact I've invented a Zamorakian blessing that works on fruit! You can use it to make Zamorak's wine out of grapes from the Vinery.

options.text: Can you help me to make Zamorak's wine?

steps.player: Can you help me to make Zamorak's wine?

steps.npc: I'll let you have access to the Zamorakian blessing I invented, so you can invoke Zamorak's unholy power upon the grapes... if I think you're up to it.
I'll want 75,000 coins too.

steps.player: And do you think I'm up to it?

steps.text: If the player has less than level 50 Prayer:

steps.npc: Nah, I bet you couldn't even bless an unholy symbol - you're not going to get very far with my grape blessing.

steps.text: You need a Prayer level of 50 to use Bologa's blessing.
If the player has at least level 50 Prayer while wearing other god items:

steps.npc: Not likely - I can see from your kit that you're supporting other gods. Dress Zamorakian if you want to impress me. And I'll still want 75,000 coins.

steps.text: If the player has at least level 50 Prayer without wearing a Zamorakian item:

steps.npc: You don't look much like a Zamorakian to me. Dress Zamorakian if you want my help. And I'll still want 75,000 coins.

steps.text: If the player has at least level 50 Prayer while wearing a Zamorakian item but does not have 75,000 coins:

steps.npc: Yeah, I guess you'll do. But I want 75,000 coins. One day I'll need to buy my own house, y'know!

steps.text: If the player has at least level 50 Prayer while wearing a Zamorakian item and having 75,000 coins:

steps.npc: Yeah, I guess you'll do. But I want 75,000 coins. One day I'll need to buy my own house, y'know!
Here's how it works... I'll write the blessing on scrolls. You need to carry some of the scrolls when you're harvesting grapes.
As each fruit is severed from its stem, it begins to die. That's the moment of vulnerability when Zamorak's unholy power can infest it.
The power consumes the scroll on which the blessing is written, so you'll need one for each grape. I suggest you take a stack of blessings with you.
By the way, Lord Zamorak's chaotic power is quite volatile. You'll likely get a smaller harvest from your vine if you're using these blessings.
I'll give the scrolls to Granddad downstairs. You can get them off him as a reward if you work on his farm. Hey, it's a dump, but he's family. So, do you accept?

options.text: Pay 75,000 coins to access Bologa's blessings.

steps.text: You pay Bologa 75,000 coins. You can now claim her blessings from Farmer Gricoller as a reward for working on his farm.

steps.npc: Meh.

options.text: You said you can make Zamorak's wine from grapes.

steps.player: You said you can make Zamorak's wine from grapes.

steps.npc: Yeah, I've invented a blessing that invokes Zamorak's unholy power upon the grapes, so Zamorak's wine can be made from them.
But I won't let you use it unless I think you're up to it. Also, I want 75,000 coins.

steps.player: And do you think I'm up to it?

steps.npc: It's really nice of you to take an interest...
